notes.title: Small difficulty adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Few difficult anomalies that were previously present in both difficulty modes have been made hard-mode-only.
[*]Some clutter has been removed from the Apartment Building and Gas Station levels.
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
These are minor changes that make some of the earlier levels a bit more unforgiving on normal difficulty without affecting the overall difficulty too much.
